title: Lockfile without a lockfile format version
description: package-lock.json declares a lockfile that declares no format version. Without the version field the installer guesses the format, and different npm releases can resolve different trees from the same file.
remediation: Regenerate the lockfile with the npm release the project supports, so the format version is explicit.
limitation: It matches a lockfile that declares no format version in the parsed package-lock.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
